recent_posts.title: Battle of the Backends
recent_posts.summary: This post discusses the pros and cons of various programming languages for web backend development, including Rust, Go, C#, and Python. The author highlights Rust's advantages in dependency handling but notes its ecosystem's immaturity. Go is praised for its environment, but its stagnation in updates is a concern. C# is appreciated for its ease of development but criticized for occasional performance issues. Python is deemed suitable only if there's existing developer expertise. A strong stance is taken against using Javascript for backends.

recent_posts.title: Viking Software A/S
recent_posts.summary: Hydrema, a Danish company specializing in advanced construction and defense equipment, sought additional development resources to update their embedded control systems with the help of Viking Software A/S. Viking Software introduced a framework called HY5, significantly reducing code complexity and enhancing flexibility and reliability. This project involved modernizing development practices, implementing GitHub for version control, and setting up CI/CD pipelines, resulting in a more efficient and adaptable software solution for Hydrema's machinery.

recent_posts.title: To Yocto or not to Yocto for embedded Linux?
recent_posts.summary: The post discusses different options for creating an operating system for an embedded board, including Yocto, board manufacturer's image, standard Linux distro, and embedded Linux distro. It highlights the pros and cons of each option and advises readers to carefully consider their specific situation.

recent_posts.title: Viking Software A/S
recent_posts.summary: Fluidan specializes in rheology control and has developed a software solution to enhance the operational efficiency and data management capabilities of their rheology machines. Their main product, RheoStream®, provides real-time rheology monitoring for thick liquids. The software solution enables technicians to interact with the machines, exchange real-time data, perform remote diagnostics, and streamline machine programming.
